title: Lines & Angles
description: Class 7 IMO — Lines & Angles: complementary and supplementary angles, adjacent angles, linear pairs, vertically opposite angles, parallel lines with a transversal, and the angle sum of a triangle.

topics.title: Complementary & Supplementary Angles
topics.concept: Two angles are complementary if they add up to 90°, and supplementary if they add up to 180°. So the complement of 30° is 60°, and the supplement of 110° is 70°.

topics.title: Linear Pair & Vertically Opposite Angles
topics.concept: Angles in a linear pair are next to each other on a straight line and add up to 180°. When two lines cross, the vertically opposite angles are equal.

examples.problem: Two angles form a linear pair and one is 120°. What is the other?
Two lines cross; one angle is 70°. What is the vertically opposite angle?

recap: A linear pair adds up to 180°.

quiz.q: Angles in a linear pair add up to ___ ?
quiz.explanation: A linear pair is supplementary, adding to 180°.

topics.title: Parallel Lines, Transversals & Triangle Angle Sum
topics.concept:
When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, 8 angles are formed with special relationships:

Angle PairRelationshipExamples
CorrespondingEQUAL1=5, 2=6, 3=7, 4=8
Alternate InteriorEQUAL3=6, 4=5
Alternate ExteriorEQUAL1=8, 2=7
Consecutive InteriorSum = 180 degrees3+5=180, 4+6=180

Consecutive interior angles are also called co-interior or same-side interior angles.

PARALLEL LINES WITH TRANSVERSAL:

     1 | 2
    ---|---  L1
     3 | 4

     5 | 6
    ---|---  L2
     7 | 8

Corresponding (equal): 1=5, 2=6, 3=7, 4=8
Alternate interior (equal): 3=6, 4=5
Alternate exterior (equal): 1=8, 2=7
Consecutive interior (sum 180): 3+5=180, 4+6=180

examples.problem: Two angles of a triangle are 60° and 70°. Find the third.
When a transversal cuts parallel lines, what is true of corresponding angles?
If angle 1 = 70 degrees, find angles 5, 3, and 6.
examples.solution: Angle 5 = 70 deg (corresponding). Angle 3 = 70 deg (vertical to angle 1). Angle 6 = 110 deg (consecutive interior: 70+110=180).

examples.problem: Alternate interior angles are (3x+20) and (5x-40) degrees. Find x.
examples.solution: Alternate interior angles are equal: 3x+20 = 5x-40 => 60 = 2x => x = 30.

recap: Corresponding and alternate interior angles are equal; co-interior angles are supplementary.
Consecutive interior angles SUM to 180 degrees

quiz.q: Two angles of a triangle are 90° and 45°. What is the third angle?
Co-interior angles between parallel lines add up to ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Co-interior angles are supplementary, adding to 180°.

questions.q: The angles of a triangle add up to ___ ?
questions.explanation: The angle sum of a triangle is 180°.

questions.q: Two angles form a linear pair and one is 70°. What is the other?
Two angles of a triangle are 50° and 60°. What is the third?
Two angles of a triangle are 90° and 30°. What is the third?
Two lines cross and one angle is 115°. What is its vertically opposite angle?
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so 115°.

questions.q: A ramp makes a 40° angle with the floor. What is its complement?
Two angles lie on a straight line; one is 65°. What is the other?
The angles of a triangle are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. What is the largest angle?
questions.explanation: Parts = 6; 180 ÷ 6 = 30, so angles are 30°, 60°, 90° — the largest is 90°.

questions.q: An angle is equal to its own complement. What is the angle?
questions.explanation: If x = 90 − x, then 2x = 90, so x = 45°.
